user_story: As a visitor, I hover/click a heatmap cell so I can see and select an onset x vowel combination.
expected_behavior: Hovering/focusing a cell updates the #dial line with language count + tier composition + observed-vs-expected ratio text; leaving the grid reverts the dial to the current selection (or the placeholder hint). Clicking a non-dim cell sets state.onset/nuc and re-renders shapes/map/langs.
bug_notes: Was FAIL - see fix_status. Original bug (race condition, reproduced headlessly): boot() writes #stamp (page looks ready) roughly 300-500ms before its OWN async default-selection chain (selectConcept for the top meaning + ensureShape for the top shape's chunk, both awaited) finishes and calls renderHeatmap()/renderShapes() again. A user who clicked a heatmap cell (or a meaning) in that window had their selection silently overwritten the moment boot()'s own pending default-selection resolved. Retested post-fix with a dedicated regression case (early click fired right when #stamp appears, then wait past the settle window): the click now sticks. 4 consecutive full harness runs, 38/38 pass, no flakiness.
fix_status: fixed: web/app.js boot() now checks !state.concept / !state.onset immediately before applying its own default selection, so a real user action that landed while the default was still in flight always wins. Added the same stale-response guard (re-check state after the await, bail if a newer selection won) to selectConcept() and selectConvMeaning(), which share the identical await-then-paint pattern.

expected_behavior: The cell shows only a bare numeral by design, but its title/aria-label and the dial line always carry tier composition (e.g. '3 curated 1 mined') alongside the count - never the numeral alone as the only signal.

user_story: As a visitor, I click a language so I can see every open-monosyllable shape it has.

user_story: As a visitor, I dismiss the bottom sheet.

feature: README reflects the actual data/pipeline state
user_story: As a new contributor reading README.md, I need its Status/module tables to describe what the app actually does today, not a stale snapshot.
expected_behavior: The Status table's dataset numbers, the 'what's blocked' claims, and the test count in 'Run it' should match the current code and data.
bug_notes: Was FAIL - see fix_status. Confirmed stale on 3 counts: (1) Status section claimed '63 languages, 1,004 shapes, 819 audio clips' and 'five CC-BY Lexibank datasets cloned' - the live build actually serves 1,926 languages / 13,819 shapes / 13,107 audio clips from 31 sources. (2) README claimed Grollemund Bantu (CC-BY-NC) is 'correctly blocked' by the licence gate as a demonstration of the block rule - but the gate's own _ALLOWED set (oms/ingest_cldf.py) was widened on 2026-07-04 to admit CC-BY-NC/CC-BY-NC-SA, and grollemundbantu IS present in data/scaled/oms-canon-v1/core.json's sources list today. (3) 'Run it' said the test suite is 20 tests; it actually runs 27, and the module table omitted oms/ingest_wikipron.py, oms/fetch_glosses.py, oms/toucan_infer.py entirely. Retested: numbers/claims/module table now verified against the live data build, the licence gate's actual _ALLOWED set, and `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` output.
fix_status: fixed: rewrote README.md's Status section, module table, and 'Run it' test count to match the current 31-source / 1,926-language / 13,819-shape / 13,107-clip build and the widened CC-BY-NC licence gate; added the 3 missing modules to the file-map table.
